services.desc: The Imagination Playground is a wide variety of large foam blocks that provide a innovative play opportunity for hours of creative building. You can truly let your imagination flow when playing with the Imagination Playground. Click “Online Registration” in the orange bar above to reserve a time to Play, Create and Learn. Parent or Guardian (over age 16) is required to attend with child(ren). We are not a drop off
